title: d1-clip-serializer — case shape (v0.1)
description: Pins the Myne dialect clip serializer (`serializeClipMarkdown`, src/dialect/clip.ts) — the @lezer/markdown-tree → canonical-D1 emitter that re-authors best-effort markdown handed off by the browser extension (capture-extraction sub-feature, browser-extension epic; markdown-dialect.md §5 canonical emit forms / §6 round-trip, SYNC-7 + SYNC-11). Each case carries a Defuddle-produced markdown source (hex) and pins the byte-exact canonical-D1 output (hex). A clip is AUTHORED content (not a C1-preserved import), so the serializer renormalizes bytes (canonical delimiters, collapsed whitespace, Setext→ATX, reference-link→inline, indented-code→fenced) as long as the emit re-parses to a structurally-identical tree and a second pass is a fixed point. Hand-curated by running the LIVE TS serializer over each fixture (no Rust generator — the serializer lives TS-side); the dialect Vitest runner asserts the live serializer byte-exact against these vectors. The Rust reference impl does not exist; this is a TS-runner category like markdown-comment / property-coercion.

vector_id.description: Stable identifier of the form 'd1-clip-serializer/v0.1/<descriptive-slug>'. Immutable once shipped.

case_kind.description: floor = the fidelity floor (faithful table / code / inline-code emission); math = inline `$…$` / block `$$…$$` emission against D1's `$`-tokenizer (incl. the degrade-to-inert-text path; task 12 extends this subset); wedge = the article wedge (headings / lists / links / emphasis / callouts / tasks / footnotes / highlights); normalize = recognized-on-parse → canonical emit (Setext→ATX, reference-link→inline, alt-emphasis-delims, indented-code→fenced); degrade = a no-emit-form construct dropped, never broken markdown.

input_markdown_utf8_hex.description: The best-effort markdown source as exact UTF-8 bytes (hex). Hex-pinned so whitespace, newlines, and delimiter placement transport unambiguously.

informational_markdown.description: Human-readable mirror of input_markdown_utf8_hex. Informational — the runner cross-checks it byte-equal against the hex; the hex is the contract.

expected_canonical_d1_utf8_hex.description: The canonical-D1 serializer output as exact UTF-8 bytes (hex): what serializeClipMarkdown(input) emits. Byte-exact; the runner asserts the live serializer produces these bytes and (per the round-trip invariant the per-construct tests pin separately) that they re-parse to a structurally-identical tree.

informational_canonical_d1.description: Human-readable mirror of expected_canonical_d1_utf8_hex (informational; hex is the contract).
